_: The settings of the tooling. Nothing here reaches a player: the runtime is the C++ under adapter-voice/src/. Every path is relative to the folder of audiolab, and no absolute path may appear in this file - it travels with the repository.
_voice: The synthesis voice for `corpus`. It is NOT shipped here - it belonged to the service that is being dissolved, and speech becomes a model mod of its own. Put a piper voice into `voices/` (that folder is ignored by git) or point this key wherever it lies.
The voice of the synthesis, in the same store and for the same reason. Piper reads ONNX and nothing else here does.
_calibration: The labelling manifest: the ground truth of the corpus. A file of its own because it is data rather than settings - the only record of which of the takes recorded before the -end/-open convention are finished phrases and which are cut off.
_weightsRoot: Where the weights of the models lie, as folders `<weightsRoot>/<models.*.weights>`. They are OUTSIDE the repository, in the modding root beside MO2 and SSEEdit, by the same rule as every other thing somebody else wrote - and split by format, because this tooling reads CTranslate2 (faster-whisper) while model-whisper-ru reads GGML (whisper.cpp). One folder for both is how a conversion of one engine ends up signed as a model of the other. Override on a machine where they lie elsewhere: the environment variable AUDIOLAB_WEIGHTS, which replaces this key whole.
_models: The python model driver - the reference one, not the one that runs in the game. These are the settings `voice.json` ran with, kept verbatim so that a word error rate measured today is comparable with docs/measurements.md. The pair fast+accurate stays: the race between two models is what the adapter has to be able to demonstrate.
_engineSettings: The tuned numbers of the ears are NOT copied here. They are read from the settings of the adapter, so that a replay always runs with the numbers the game runs with; a missing file is not an error, because the defaults built into the python are the same numbers. Override: the environment variable AUDIOLAB_ENGINE.
_vocabulary: The hint of words to expect. The model is free not to use it; measured on the bench corpus, a prompt turns «Пайербол» into «фаербол» for both models and costs the small one a whole sentence on the long take.

reputations._: The product of the calibration: how far each model may be believed. The adapter reads a COPY shipped inside its own mod, not this file.

bench._: The synthesised corpus: the reference text is known EXACTLY because we pronounced it ourselves. Deliberately uneven - single commands, four sentences in a row, the case of «a command that turned out to be the beginning of a phrase», and plain silence as a check against invention. `gapsMs` are the pauses between sentences: piper makes none of its own, it voices what it was given.

sentences: Ты зачем надел эту броню, она же тяжёлая и медленная?

scenario._: The joint of the two halves: the engine writes the lines the bridge is checked against, instead of a person writing them by hand. `out` is a key and not a hard-coded path on purpose - the bridge may be checked out anywhere; the file itself is derived and is not versioned.
